haikus.haiku:
Red berries swirl sweet
Creamy clouds drift above sky
Taste of summer sighs
Happy #NationalStrawberryCreamPieDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Bright moon hums above
Kids giggle, light sparks in sky
Questions rise like stars
Happy #AskAStupidQuestion

Gentle snowflakes fall
Wise breeze carries old tales soft
Joy rings in quiet
#HappyBirthdayConfucius from @ClamBakeSanta

Soft light drifts on walls
Painted dreams swirl bright in air
Joy blooms in each frame
#HappyBirthdayMichelangeloAntonioni from @ClamBakeSanta
